item.title: New Mikvah Being Constructed in Alma-Ata
item.description: A new mikvah is being built at the Chabad centers in Almaty, Kazakhstan, in memory of Rebbetzin Chana Schneerson, the mother of the Rebbe.

item.title: Live: 30 Letters in 30 Days
item.description: Live at 10:00 PM ET: Rabbi Shais Taub re-launches his annual “Thirty Letters in Thirty Days” live series, beginning Motzei Shabbos at 10 PM ET, as a 30-day preparation for the Rebbe’s birthday featuring nightly classes on letters from Volume 12 of Igros Kodesh.

item.title: Why the Iranian Guards Didn’t Confiscate the Tanya
item.description: Israeli journalist and Arab affairs expert Tzvi Yehezkeli shared a story of how the Tanya once gained the unexpected approval of the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC).

item.title: F.R.E.E. to Distribute Food in Crown Heights
item.description: Chabad F.R.E.E. NYC will be organizing its annual Pesach Food Distribution - Tuesday, March 24 - in Crown Heights, on President Street, (between Schenectady and Utica) from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM prompt.

item.title: Netanyahu Receives Shmurah Matzah From Kfar Chabad
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu received handmade Shmura Matzah for Pesach from the bakery in the village of Kfar Chabad.

item.title: “Pesach Cleaning Isn’t Spring Cleaning”
item.description: In a video shared this week, San Antonio Shliach Rabbi Chaim Block explained what the meaning of Pesach cleaning is, and shared a story that led to a revelation by the moderator.

item.title: Preparations for 11 Nissan Parade in Florida Underway
item.description: In honor of Yud Alef Nissan, a Mitzvah Tank Parade will depart from the Lubavitch Educational Center (LEC) to drive through Miami and disperse to various mivtzoim locations to distribute Shmurah Matzah and help Yidden with Tefillin.

item.title: L'Chaim: Rotenberg - Blesofsky
item.description: The L'Chaim of Naftali Rotenberg of Crown Heights and Mushka Blesofsky of Iowa City, IA took place at the Jewish Children’s Museum in Crown Heights.

item.title: New Single Features the Story of Elisha and the Widow
item.description: Singer/songwriter Shlomo Gleyzer has released a stirring new song titled Elisha, inspired by the well-known story in Sefer Melachim II (4:1-7) of the widow who cries out to the prophet Elisha and is saved through the miracle of oil.

item.title: You Can Win: A Living Thread
item.description: A piece of fabric from the dress of the Rebbetzin Chaya Mushka a"h will be given to one person who gives to The Space — a home for Jewish women and girls to grow, connect, and thrive.
